values.note: First come, first served; overnight camping by permit only, from the pay stations at the southwest corner of the Town Park lot or the south end of the bridge in Circle Park. Fees due by 11 a.m. daily; checks payable to Town of Meeker. Only pavilions take reservations.

Fees must be paid by 11:00 a.m. daily'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: RV camping $30 a day per the camping rules (the same page's fee list says $20); tent camping $10 a day in Circle Park.

values.note: RV dump and potable-water fill station at 5th and Water Streets; all-season restrooms in Town Park, a vault toilet in Circle Park.

note: Town of Meeker park on the White River in downtown Meeker: RV camping in Town Park (with electricity), tent spots across the bridge in Circle Park. Trailers at least 10 ft apart; no generators 9 p.m. - 7 a.m.; no open fires. Sites are small and close together; a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
summary: Town parks page: confirmed FCFS self-pay (no reservations). Added fees $30/day RV (2026; the page's fee list says $20), 7-day limit, potable-water fill and dump station. Note: dropped the rates (now in fees) and the 'no reservation system' line (in booking); kept the river/bridge layout and fit remark. Not stated anywhere: electric amperage, RV site count, a camping season.
flags: Fee conflict on the town's own page: the camping rules say 'RV Camping • 7-day limit at $30 per day' and the Fees list says 'RV Camping: $20 per day'. Recorded $30; the town fee schedule (May 2025) lists no camping fee. Town Hall 970-878-5344 could settle it.
Electric: the page lists 'electricity' among Town Park's features but never says RV sites have hookups or gives an amperage; hookups left unset.
Season: no statement of when camping is open (the page mentions 'all season restrooms'); left unset. No RV site count published.
Phone 970-878-5344 is Meeker Town Hall (published on the page, weekdays 8-5); after hours the page gives non-emergency dispatch 970-878-5555.
